title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in hupe13 Extension…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the hupe13 Extension for Leaflet Map through version 6.1.1. This flaw allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker to inject malicious scripts that execute in the context of affected users.
